summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title (terminal check only, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run and no commit was made, per instructions; verification was by reading only.
